verdict.rationale: Payout scheduling and payout-level reconciliation are fair questions for a payments platform like Asaas, so the axis applies. The pack never documents controlling a payout schedule or breaking a payout down into its charges, fees and refunds. Receivables anticipation, fast Pix settlement and generic receivables management are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
